_about: Fameland (levels 20-30): the hall of heroes. Its first halls are quiet; deeper, the spectral champions test the living and answer each other's horn. Weeping shades haunt the Chambers of Sorrow, honour guards stand in the Honor Rooms, the Keeper of Mercy and the Mourner are its elites, and the First Hero waits on the Way of Heroes and calls the fallen champions to his side.

42000.name: champion spectral
42000.long_desc: A spectral champion in ancient armour stands to attention, then turns to face you.
42000.description: A hero of some forgotten war, pale and translucent, the wounds that killed them still showing through the mail. They test every living soul who walks these halls.

helpers.shout: A horn sounds from nowhere, and the honoured dead answer!

42001.name: honour guard spirit
42001.long_desc: An honour guard spirit stands motionless beside the honour roll.
42001.description: A ghostly soldier in parade armour, sword grounded, eyes fixed ahead. It guards the names of the honoured dead.

helpers.shout: A horn sounds from nowhere, and the honoured dead answer!

42002.name: shade weeping
42002.long_desc: A weeping shade drifts through the chamber, sobbing for the fallen.
42002.description: A grey wisp of a figure with its face in its hands. Its grief is cold enough to frost the marble where it passes.

42010.name: keeper mercy
42010.long_desc: The Keeper of Mercy stands by an eternal flame, hands folded on a sword.
42010.description: A tall spirit in white, who granted mercy to the defeated in life. To the living who come armed into these halls she grants none.

helpers.shout: A horn sounds from nowhere, and the honoured dead answer!

42011.name: mourner
42011.long_desc: The Mourner kneels in the small chamber, keening over an empty bier.
42011.description: Veiled in black from head to foot, the Mourner has wept here for centuries; to disturb that grief is to share it.

42030.name: first hero
42030.long_desc: The First Hero stands upon the Way of Heroes, blade drawn, waiting for a worthy foe.
42030.description: The first name on the first honour roll: a giant of a warrior in bronze armour green with age, a crested helm and a sword as long as a man. He has waited a thousand years for someone worth fighting.

phases.message: The First Hero raises his sword in salute: "At last, a worthy foe!"

abilities.name: Hero's Cleave
abilities.telegraph: The First Hero sweeps his great sword back for a mighty cleave!

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.telegraph: The First Hero levels his blade at you: "Face me!"

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.telegraph: The First Hero plants his feet and calls upon a thousand years of glory!

patrols.why: a champion walks the Halls of Eternity

bosses.why: the First Hero on the Way of Heroes

mechanics.shout: The First Hero roars: "Champions of Fameland, to me!"
mechanics.why: the fallen champions come to his side

_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 7 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim

42090.room_desc: A tarnished hero's longsword lies here.
42090.description: A long straight blade gone grey with age, the names of old battles etched down the fuller. It is colder than steel ought to be.

42091.room_desc: An honour guard's breastplate lies here.
42091.description: A polished breastplate chased with laurel leaves in gold, worn by the dead who stand forever in the Honour Rooms.

42092.short_desc: a mourning veil of grey silk
42092.room_desc: A mourning veil of grey silk lies here.
42092.description: A long veil of fine grey silk, damp as if with tears that never dry. The weeping shades of the Chambers of Sorrow wear them.

42093.short_desc: a silver phial of the Keeper's mercy
42093.description: A little silver phial stoppered with wax and stamped with an open hand. The draught inside closes wounds as gently as it was given.

42094.short_desc: a bronze lamp of eternal flame
42094.room_desc: A bronze lamp lies here, a small flame burning steadily in it.
42094.description: A squat bronze lamp taken from the braziers of the halls, its little flame burning without oil or wick.

42095.short_desc: a laurel crown of the First Hero
42095.room_desc: A crown of golden laurel leaves lies here.
42095.description: A circlet of beaten gold laurel leaves, worn smooth by a hero's brow over a thousand years of honour. Its wearer stands a little taller.
